appDescription: An application that summarizes published apartment sale transactions and manages areas of interest for home exploration.

function.name: GET_AREA_PRICE_SUMMARY
function.description: Returns an apartment sale transaction summary for a specified area or the current vehicle area.

areaQuery.description: The name of the area to inspect, or an explicit reference to the current vehicle area.

function.name: SAVE_INTEREST_AREA
function.description: Saves an area of interest to the active application profile using a specified area or available area context.

areaQuery.description: The name of the area to save, or an explicit reference to the current vehicle area.

function.name: GET_REAL_ESTATE_BRIEFING
function.description: Returns published apartment transaction updates, housing subscription announcements, and selected news for the active profile's saved areas.
